prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original Manual de Cocina recipe photograph. A single realistic food photo, 4:3 landscape framing, soft natural window light, clean light neutral kitchen counter, simple unbranded transparent glasses and blender, accurate natural fruit textures. No text, label, watermark, collage, extra ingredients, milk, yogurt, sugar, artificial colouring, blue-coloured liquid or garnish. The drink is thick fruit puree, not clear filtered juice. Finished rainbow fruit drink in four identical plain transparent 350 ml tumblers, standing close together, each filled with four fairly equal thick fruit puree layers. Exact order BOTTOM TO TOP: deep purple blueberry, strawberry pink, green kiwi with tiny seed flecks, golden yellow-orange mango. Natural slightly soft wavy boundaries, not artificially perfect geometric stripes. No blue layer, no extra white layer, no fruit garnish. One simple long spoon lies beside the glasses. Show all four colours clearly in all glasses, realistic volume around 270 g per glass. Central generous composition with crop margin for square, 4:3 and 16:9 cover variants.
